approval_policy.description: Approval policy for the Booking Search Agent

add_search_provider.notes: Granting or swapping the search skill. Owner reads its SKILL.md and the provider's terms first: search-only, automated queries permitted, no scraping or challenge solving.

emergency_stop.notes: Anyone using the channel or the owner can stop searches immediately. Only the owner can resume.

forbidden.booking_or_payment: Booking, holding, or paying for any room. The traveller books via the link. Not approvable by anyone.
forbidden.guest_pii_entry: Sending guest names, contact details, or payment data to any provider. Not approvable by anyone.
forbidden.anti_bot_circumvention: Solving or bypassing CAPTCHA, WAF, bot checks, or rate limits. Not approvable by anyone.
forbidden.unauthorized_scraping: Scraping any site whose terms don't permit automated access. Not approvable by anyone.
